question: Name the foreign name of the card that has boros watermark? List out the type of this card.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching foreign_data record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'boros'
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.name, T1.type FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid WHERE T1.watermark = 'boros'

d.request: What is the foreign name and the card type of the card that has the boros watermark, including cards that have no matching foreign_data record?
d.sql: SELECT fd.name, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'

b.request: What is the foreign-language name and the type of each card with the boros watermark, including cards that have no matching foreign_data record (so the foreign name may be missing)?
b.sql: SELECT fd.name AS foreign_name, c.type FROM cards c LEFT JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'

c.request:
